'''August 2000 Las Vegas tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Las Vegas on 5 August 2000. [[Chris Hines]] won it. It is known from John Spadora's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1087">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-05-las-vegas-8-05-2000-the-mans-reportd1087/ las-vegas-8-05-2000-the-mans-report], DeckTech (John "The Man" Spadora, 5 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-05-las-vegas-8-05-2000-the-mans-reportd1087/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 5 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Las Vegas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Hines]]
